end.summary:
- Reviewed the Cartesian coordinate system and ordered pairs.
- Harsh identified x as horizontal and y as vertical.
- Harsh explained that (3, 2) and (2, 3) plot at different locations.
- Harsh correctly identified quadrants from coordinate signs in most attempts.
- Teach-back was not passed; plotting a point from an ordered pair needs more practice.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading ordered pairs, moving horizontally and vertically, and identifying quadrants from coordinate signs with Harsh. They clearly explained why (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points, and corrected the mix-up about a point with both negative coordinates later in the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to plot three ordered pairs on squared paper and name each quadrant.
